title: SIFT: Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer for Multi-Task Personalized Filter Ranking at Airbnb
title_zh: SIFT：面向 Airbnb 多任务个性化筛选排序的搜索意图到筛选 Transformer
abstract_en: Search filters help guests navigate vast catalogs in two-sided marketplaces like Airbnb, and recommending the right filters can meaningfully lift booking conversion. Many such production filter-ranking systems, however, represent the guest through hand-engineered, pre-aggregated features generated by ETL pipelines. This makes it expensive to maintain and difficult to extend for new filter types or contextual dimensions (trip length, group size). We present SIFT (Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer), a ranking model built on transformers that learns guest preferences directly from raw behavioral sequences. SIFT replaces manual feature engineering with a unified guest representation that feeds multiple prediction tasks, including booking likelihood, filter engagement, and ordinal capacity thresholds (e.g., 2+ bedrooms) -- a general framework for filter ranking in two-sided marketplaces that accommodates both boolean and numeric-range filter types. Extending SIFT to new filters requires only adding a new head, not a new feature pipeline. To keep serving fast, this guest representation is computed offline on a daily cadence rather than at request time. Offline, SIFT improves booking and amenity-engagement PR-AUC by +51.9% and +62.8% respectively over the production baseline. In online A/B testing, SIFT increased engagement with recommended filters by +20.0%, overall filter usage among searchers by +0.72%, and usage of the newly-supported bedroom, bathroom, and bed filters by +3.9%, +10.7%, and +0.52% respectively. Demonstrating the system's extensibility, we rapidly integrated a novel hotel-intent filter using the same shared representation, driving a +3.8% lift in uncancelled hotel bookings and a +0.76% lift in overall marketplace bookings. SIFT is now fully deployed in production, serving scalable personalization to millions of guests.
abstract_zh: Airbnb 等双边市场中的搜索筛选器可帮助房客浏览海量房源，推荐合适的筛选条件能够提升预订转化。传统生产系统依赖通过 ETL 流程生成的手工设计与预聚合特征，维护成本高，也难以扩展新的筛选类型和上下文维度。本文提出 SIFT（Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer），一种基于 Transformer 的筛选排序模型，直接从原始行为序列中学习房客偏好，并生成统一的房客表示，以支持预订概率、筛选互动以及有序容量阈值（如 2 间及以上卧室）等多项预测任务。该框架同时支持布尔型和数值范围型筛选器；扩展新筛选器时只需增加预测头，无需重新构建特征流水线。为满足在线服务延迟要求，房客表示按日离线计算，而非在请求时生成。离线实验显示，相较生产基线，SIFT 的预订和设施互动 PR-AUC 分别提升 51.9% 和 62.8%。在线 A/B 测试中，推荐筛选器互动提升 20.0%，搜索用户整体筛选使用率提升 0.72%；新支持的卧室、浴室和床位筛选器使用率分别提升 3.9%、10.7% 和 0.52%。借助共享表示，团队还快速接入了新的酒店意图筛选器，使未取消酒店预订提升 3.8%，整体市场预订提升 0.76%。SIFT 已部署到生产环境，为数百万房客提供可扩展的个性化服务。
key_points_zh: 以原始行为序列学习统一房客表示，替代依赖 ETL 的手工特征工程，降低维护与扩展成本。
通过多任务学习同时预测预订概率、筛选互动和有序容量阈值，兼容布尔型与数值范围型筛选器。
离线实验中，预订和设施互动 PR-AUC 相较生产基线分别提升 51.9% 和 62.8%。
在线 A/B 测试显示，推荐筛选器互动提升 20.0%，整体筛选使用率提升 0.72%。
新增筛选器仅需添加预测头；酒店意图筛选器带来未取消酒店预订提升 3.8%，并使整体市场预订提升 0.76%。

llm_assessment.comment: SIFT directly advances customer-facing marketplace search through scalable personalized filter ranking and demonstrates substantial production gains at Airbnb.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: SIFT 通过可扩展的个性化筛选排序直接提升面向用户的 marketplace 搜索，并在 Airbnb 生产环境中取得了显著收益。
